name: Kamikaze
doc: Kamikaze (the command ability: a party member's self-destruct, Suicide 180 adapted): its glow, flares flying off it, the screen fade, the rings, the sparks, the smoke, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag181_kamikaze.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: A party member's self-destruct: its glow, the flares flying off it, the screen fade, the rings, the sparks, the smoke, the sound; the damage

groups.label: Flares
groups.doc: Ticks 4 and 5: Count, then Count - 1 flares flying off the caster at Speed + rand % Speed spread, size Size + rand % Size spread

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the director

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 13 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Smoke
params.doc: The sprite sequence smoke (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Flare
params.doc: The sprite sequence flare (a flipbook of 7 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 234 vertices, 216 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Ring2 model
params.doc: The prim model ring2 (a mesh of 144 vertices, 96 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
